arrogant_showboating__3.text_en: Create a Might token for each defending card controlled by an opponent on the combat chain.
arrogant_showboating__3.text_zh: 为对手在战斗链上控制的每张防御牌创造一个力量衍生物。

bad_breath__1.text_en:
Intimidate target hero.
The next time an attack you control hits this turn, create 3 Might tokens.
Go again
bad_breath__1.text_zh:
威吓目标英雄。
本回合你控制的攻击下一次命中时，创造3个力量衍生物。
再动

bask_in_your_own_greatness__1.text_en: When this attacks, you may pay up to {r}{r}{r}. Create that many Might tokens.
bask_in_your_own_greatness__1.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以支付至多3点资源。创造等量的力量衍生物。

bask_in_your_own_greatness__2.text_en: When this attacks, you may pay up to {r}{r}{r}. Create that many Might tokens.
bask_in_your_own_greatness__2.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以支付至多3点资源。创造等量的力量衍生物。

battered_beaten_and_broken__2.text_en:
When this attacks a hero, intimidate them.
If you control 3 or more auras, this gets +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, destroy an intimidated card they own."
battered_beaten_and_broken__2.text_zh:
当此牌攻击英雄时，威吓该英雄。
若你控制3个或更多光环，此牌获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁该英雄拥有的一张被威吓的牌。”

booze__3.text_en:
Go again
When this enters or leaves the arena, the crowd boos you.
At the start of your turn, destroy this.
booze__3.text_zh:
再动
当此牌进入或离开竞技场时，观众为你喝倒彩。
在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌。

bully_tactics__1.text_en: When this attacks a hero, you may pay up to {r}{r}{r}. Intimidate them that many times.
bully_tactics__1.text_zh: 当此牌攻击英雄时，你可以支付至多3点资源。威吓该英雄等量的次数。

cheap_shot__2.text_en:
If you've been booed this turn, you may play this as though it were an instant.
Deal 2 damage to target hero unless they discard a card.
cheap_shot__2.text_zh:
若本回合你被喝倒彩过，你可以将此牌当作瞬间使用。
对目标英雄造成2点伤害，除非其弃一张牌。

clench_the_upper_hand__1.text_en: When this attacks or defends, if you have less {h} than each other hero, the crowd boos you.
clench_the_upper_hand__1.text_zh: 当此牌攻击或防御时，若你的生命低于其他每位英雄，观众为你喝倒彩。

concealed_object__3.text_en:
When this enters the arena, the crowd boos you.
Instant - {t}: Target attack gets +1{p}.
At the beginning of your end phase, destroy this.
concealed_object__3.text_zh:
当此牌进入竞技场时，观众为你喝倒彩。
瞬间——横置此牌：目标攻击获得+1力量。
在你的结束阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。

cruel_ambition__1.text_zh:
创造3个力量衍生物。
再动

disdainful_delight__2.text_en: While this is defending, if you've been booed this turn, this gets +1{d}.
disdainful_delight__2.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，若本回合你被喝倒彩过，此牌获得+1防御。

escalate_violence__3.text_en: When this attacks, if you control a Might token, create 3 more.
escalate_violence__3.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若你控制一个力量衍生物，再创造3个。

fight_dirty__1.text_en:
If this is defended by a Revered card, this gets +1{p}.
When this hits a Revered hero, destroy the top card of their deck.
fight_dirty__1.text_zh:
若此牌被崇敬牌防御，此牌获得+1力量。
当此牌命中崇敬英雄时，摧毁其牌库顶的一张牌。

fix_the_match__2.text_en:
When this attacks, search your deck for a card, then shuffle and put that card on top.
Whenever a card defends this, clash with the defending hero. The winner creates a Might token.
fix_the_match__2.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，然后洗牌并将该牌置于牌库顶。
每当牌防御此牌时，与防御英雄交锋。胜者创造一个力量衍生物。

gang_robbery__2.text_en:
When this attacks a hero, steal an aura token they control.
If you control 3 or more auras, this gets +3{p}.
gang_robbery__2.text_zh:
当此牌攻击英雄时，偷取其控制的一个光环衍生物。
若你控制3个或更多光环，此牌获得+3力量。

goon_battery__3.text_en: If you control 3 or more auras, this gets +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, {t} them."

goon_beatdown__3.text_en: If you control 3 or more auras, this gets +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, the crowd boos you."

If you have more {h} than each other hero, you may play this as though it were an instant.
When this enters the arena, name a card. The named card can't be played from hand while this is in the arena.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this.

若你的生命高于其他每位英雄，你可以将此牌当作瞬间使用。
当此牌进入竞技场时，说出一张牌名。当此牌在竞技场中时，被说出的牌不能从手牌使用。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。

overturn_the_results__3.text_en: If you would fail to win a clash revealing this, instead you win the clash and the crowd boos you.
